lines.en: I climb along the leaf's back.
Every step sticks to the leaf.
The wood is dim and the leaves are soft.
I chew out a small path.
I arch my back and lower it.
Dozens of legs, moving in order.
The underside is my road.
I'm slow, but I never stop.
Finish one, climb to the next.

lines.zh: 这里的叶子比丘陵上的厚
lines.en: The leaves here are thicker than the hills'.
I go around the stem.

lines.zh: 细丝拖着，是我走过留的
lines.en: A thin thread trails where I've passed.

lines.zh: 风一吹，叶子翻过来，我抓着
lines.en: The wind flips the leaf and I grip.
The light spots above me move.
I go around my kin and press on.

lines.zh: 这一棵树的叶子够吃很久
lines.en: This tree has leaves to last a long while.
I'm wrapped in the leaf.
I chew without moving my eyes.
There's water on the vein; I licked it.

lines.zh: 身上的颜色和林子很配
lines.en: My color matches the wood.
I don't dare leave the tree.
The leaf edge is chewed into a curve.
I'm waiting to grow up.
The leaf beside moved; that's wind.
I rest on a thin twig.
This wood stays dim all day.
I eat a whole leaf a day.
The one behind is following me.
You're looking up at me.
Don't touch the leaf; I'd fall.
Half of me is hidden by the leaf.
To catch me you'd have to pick the leaf.
I'm only a worm.
I'm eating, not looking at you.
This leaf is my place.
Your shadow is darker than the wood.

lines.zh: 再等等，我就变成别的了
lines.en: Wait, and I'll become something else.
Are you going to move me?
I curl into a ball.
Green juice stains the leaf.
One gripping foot slipped.
I dropped to the leaf below.
It hurts; I can't move.
I knocked the leaf askew.
Not another one.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上滑下去，抓不住。
lines.en: I slip off the leaf and can't hold on.
Leaves; I only know leaves.
This one's a bit old.
Hand the leaf over.
Tender shoots are best.
Don't tease me with anything else.
Swap the leaf and I'll come over.
This one smells fine.
Put it beside me, don't hold it.
I can't finish it; I'll save it.
You knocked the leaf crooked.
I held tight and didn't fall.
Don't push me.
You touched my back.
I shifted toward the leaf's middle.
Two of us crowded on one leaf.
I nearly slid off.
I retreat to the stem.
I still need to grow.
There are others on the tree.
Two of us chew leaves together.
Afterward we each make a chrysalis.
The wood is big enough for all.

lines.zh: 我还没结蛹，谈这个太早。
lines.en: I haven't pupated yet; far too early.
What we do is very simple.
Wait until we can fly.
The leaf is in my way.
Don't make noise, I'm eating.
I only hold leaves in my mouth.
What falls is beyond my reach.
I drag a small piece with my mouth.
I can't bite this.
There's a speck on the leaf.

lines.zh: 我用头顶着一片叶子挪动。
lines.en: I nudge a leaf along with my head.
I can't carry it; I'm too soft.
Leaves are what I want.
Crumbs count too.
The ground is all fallen leaves.
A good leaf ahead.
On the branch above.
I see the edge.
That one hasn't been chewed.
Not far.
The twigs connect.
Move over slowly.
That one.
I need to shift my grip first.
I'll eat once I'm there.
Inch by inch.
The stem is a little thin.
I go around a hole.
The wind pushes the leaf back.
A little more.
Almost within reach.
I stretch my head to test.
This distance works.
Don't rush, I'd fall.
Here.
I butted once.
I bite the leaf, not you.
Soft, with little force.
I curl up.
I twist my body.
I can't dodge, only curl.
That tore the leaf.
I have no teeth.
Even a touch stings.
A small egg split on the leaf's back.
I crawl out of the egg.
My first bite is forest leaf.
A hole appears on the leaf's back.
I grip the vein.
Kin are moving on the tree.
I look up; the wood is dark.
Dew wets me.
It's much wetter here than the hills.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，叶子先卷起来
lines.en: Flame neared and the leaf curled first.
I fell from the leaf onto soil.

lines.zh: 水把我压在叶上，动不了
lines.en: Water pins me to the leaf.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从叶上刮下去
lines.en: The blast scraped me off the leaf.
Something thin went through me.
The spell hit and I went rigid.
No leaves, and I'm drying.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我抖得厉害
lines.en: Lightning hit the tree and I shook hard.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有叶子，只有黑
lines.en: No leaves in the void, only dark.
